## Layered Architecture (Constitution I)

- [ ] CHK001 Staging models use `{{ source() }}` — no raw table references
- [ ] CHK002 Mart models use `{{ ref() }}` — no source calls or raw table names
- [ ] CHK003 Staging models materialized as `view`
- [ ] CHK004 Mart models materialized as `table` (or `incremental` if justified)
- [ ] CHK005 No cross-layer violations (marts don't call sources directly)

## Semantic Layer (Constitution II)

- [ ] CHK006 Mart models with quantitative data have `semantic_models:` entries
- [ ] CHK007 Business metrics defined as dbt metrics — not ad-hoc SQL
- [ ] CHK008 Saved queries created for common metric combinations

## Testing (Constitution III)

- [ ] CHK009 `unique` + `not_null` tests on all primary keys
- [ ] CHK010 `relationships` tests on all foreign keys
- [ ] CHK011 `accepted_values` tests where domain is known
- [ ] CHK012 Unit tests for non-trivial logic (CASE WHEN, window functions, date math)
- [ ] CHK013 `dbt_utils.expression_is_true` for cross-column assertions
- [ ] CHK014 All tests pass via `dbt build --select [model]`

## Documentation (Constitution IV)

- [ ] CHK015 All models have descriptions stating the grain
- [ ] CHK016 All columns have descriptions explaining business meaning
- [ ] CHK017 Source YAML includes `loaded_at_field` and `freshness` where applicable
- [ ] CHK018 YAML files colocated with SQL counterparts

## Code Quality

- [ ] CHK019 SQL follows CTE pattern (no subqueries in FROM)
- [ ] CHK020 Lowercase keywords, 4-space indent, trailing commas
- [ ] CHK021 SQLFluff lint passes with zero violations
- [ ] CHK022 Line length ≤ 80 characters
- [ ] CHK023 File names use snake_case, staging models have `stg_` prefix

## Cost-Aware Development (Constitution V)

- [ ] CHK024 All `dbt` commands use `--select` — no full project runs
- [ ] CHK025 Data previewed with `dbt show --limit N` before materializing

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items map to constitution principles for traceability
